name: Minon Weber
title: Talent Engagement Specialist, Zurich
quote:
Mohammed was such a great support across multiple projects at EF Academy. He was always quick to jump in, happy to help, and incredibly patient.

What stood out to me was his ability to make complex things easy to understand and explain them clearly and calmly, which made collaboration so smooth and productive. His reliability and adaptability ensured that deliverables were always on time and aligned with the project's needs.

On top of all that, Mohammed is just a great person to work with—cheerful, approachable, and bringing positive energy to every call!
